Method of Attack: Multi-phase phishing campaign using stolen credentials to register devices onto the target's network and distribute phishing emails
Use of DocuSign-themed phishing emails to steal email credentials
Phishing URL imitating Office 365 login page with pre-filled username
Creation of malicious inbox rules to delete IT notification emails and non-delivery reports
Registration of attacker devices in Azure Active Directory using stolen credentials to send phishing emails from trusted workspace
Sending SharePoint-themed phishing emails with malicious attachments
Attack Vector: Phishing emails with DocuSign and SharePoint themes
Azure AD device registration via Outlook first launch experience
Malicious inbox rules created via PowerShell cmdlet New-InboxRule
Indicators of Compromise: Phishing URLs imitating Office 365 login page
Suspicious Azure AD device registration events
